targets.rawSql: SELECT Dimension1 AS stage, sum(Value) AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'journey_same_session_funnel' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY multiIf(stage='startup', 1, stage='project', 2, stage='asset', 3, stage='first_edit', 4, stage='preview', 5, stage='save', 6, stage='export', 7, 99)
SELECT MetricDate AS time, Dimension1 AS metric, Value AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'journey_same_session_funnel' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Operation outcomes (success, partial, failed, cancelled, blocked, queued)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Dimension1 AS operation, Dimension2 AS outcome, sum(Value) AS event_count FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'event_outcomes' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) GROUP BY operation, outcome ORDER BY event_count DESC
